tools.name: Photo Tools
tools.description: Crop, resize and compress photos. Set exact dimensions, DPI and KB limits, or make a printable photo sheet.
tools.longDescription: Edit photos privately in your browser: crop, rotate, flip, adjust brightness and contrast, export JPG or PNG with DPI metadata, save custom presets and create 4 × 6 inch or A4 print sheets.

tools.description: Generate passport-size photo sheets instantly from any image. Supports multiple formats and layouts.
tools.longDescription: A powerful online tool that converts regular photos into perfectly sized passport photos. Upload any image, auto-crop to standard passport dimensions, and generate printable sheets with multiple copies. Supports various international passport photo standards.
tools.name: Instant Passport Photo

Movies & TV Shows
tools.description: A hand-checked list of streaming and download sources for movies and TV shows. Search the list and open any source in a new tab.
tools.longDescription: Browse movie and TV show sources in one directory. Search by name, filter the list and open a source in a new tab. SanuwarTools does not host, stream or upload any video.

tools.name: Anime
tools.description: Anime streaming directories with subbed and dubbed catalogues. Keep an ad blocker on before opening a player.
tools.longDescription: A separate anime directory with sub and dub streaming sources, season catalogues and weekly episode mirrors. Search the list or open a source directly.

tools.name: Manga
tools.description: Manga readers and scanlation archives with searchable libraries, chapter lists and reading progress.
tools.longDescription: Find manga readers and scanlation archives in one list. Open a library, search a title and continue from a chapter list.

tools.name: Live Sports
tools.description: Live sports stream directories for cricket, football, hockey and more. Refresh the source if a feed drops.
tools.longDescription: A match-day directory of live sports streams. Schedules and mirror links change often; refresh the source or pick another mirror when a feed stops.

tools.name: Live TV
tools.description: Live TV and IPTV web players with news, entertainment and 24/7 channel lists. Availability depends on region.
tools.longDescription: Open live TV and IPTV web players from one directory. Channel availability varies by country and by the source you choose.

tools.name: Torrents
tools.description: Public torrent indexes for movies, TV, software and more. Use a client you trust and check what you download.
tools.longDescription: A public torrent index directory with magnets and tracker listings for movies, TV, software and games. Always check files before opening them.

tools.name: Games
tools.description: PC game download and repack directories. Read the installer notes and scan files before running anything.
tools.longDescription: Browse game repack and download sources. Read the installer notes, verify checksums where available and scan files before running them.

tools.name: Music
tools.description: Spotify rips, YouTube MP3 and multi-service downloaders, grouped by source and desktop software.
tools.longDescription: A music download directory grouped into Spotify, YouTube, multi-service tools and desktop software. Each card opens the source in a new tab.

tools.name: eBooks
tools.description: eBook libraries, audiobook archives and desktop readers, grouped by format so you can pick a reader first.
tools.longDescription: Find eBook libraries, audiobook archives and PDF or browser readers in one place. Search the catalogue, then download a format your reader supports.

tools.name: Comics
tools.description: Comic readers, digital shops and issue archives. Check the format before downloading a full run.
tools.longDescription: A comic source directory with readers, digital shops and issue archives. Check the file format and issue numbering before downloading a full run.

tools.name: Asian Drama
tools.description: Korean, Japanese, Chinese and Thai drama sources with subtitles, often updated same-day.
tools.longDescription: Browse Asian drama streaming directories covering K, J, C and Thai series. Subtitles and episode updates vary by source.

tools.name: VPN
tools.description: Virtual private network services with apps for phones, desktops and browsers. Compare policies before subscribing.
tools.longDescription: Compare VPN services with official links only. Check logging policies, speeds, device limits and the price of a yearly plan before subscribing.

tools.name: AdBlockers
tools.description: Browser extensions and privacy browsers that block intrusive ads, trackers and popunders.
tools.longDescription: Install an ad blocker before opening any streaming or download directory. This list covers browser extensions and browsers with built-in blocking.
